name: Grand Hotel Swanage
accommodation: Single to family rooms, with sea, garden or Purbeck Hills views
beachAccess: Hotel has its own sandy beach
confirmedFeatures: Burlington Health Spa (sauna, jacuzzi, plunge pool, gym), Coast Restaurant, conservatory, lounge bar, events spaces
overview: A clifftop hotel above Swanage Bay with rooms ranging from singles to family rooms. Guests have access to the hotel's own sandy beach, plus a health spa with gym, sauna and plunge pool, and a restaurant and bar.
surfTripFit: Its own beach below the hotel and a spa for recovery make it a comfortable base for checking Swanage Bay.
